name: write_discovery_u
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,json,hashlib,base64,datetime,re
p=pathlib.Path.cwd();raw=json.loads((p/'raw-provenance.json').read_text())['records']
notes={
'356717':('PARK_LOWER_BOUND','C.6 in 2211.00699v2: source proves interval nonvanishing and upper bound, not n-b lower bound. Deletion/contraction needs control of the maps at the extreme degree; exactness does not imply survival of a nonzero class. Blocks and disconnected/edgeless conventions remain fidelity qualifications.','Need nonzero degree at least n-b-1 for every source-domain graph with all connecting-map cancellations controlled.'),
'356728':('HOLD_SHIFTED_POSITIVITY','Conjecture4.36 in arxiv v2 and journal, equations4.17/4.19/4.20 and Proposition4.23 read. Strict partitions, finite nonnegative Z[beta] spans, double-slash corner sum. Ordinary interval support is unrelated. Detailed duality/positive-skew attempts in ORDINARY-ATTEMPTS.md.','Need nonnegative double-slash GQ coefficients (equivalently gp multiplication constants) for all strict partitions, and current concretely matching follow-up theorem bodies. Search yields unverified nonprimary skew-positivity lead; not a proof.'),
'356778':('PARK_LOGIC','Source Conjecture1 exact FO+MOD transduction equivalence. FO to FOM is immediate inclusion; reverse must replace modulo-counting interpretations uniformly across arbitrary infinite classes. A single parity-distinguishable pair of graphs does not separate transduction closures because unary colors/copying may change the interpretation.','Uniform FO replacement or a class-level transduction invariant separating the closures; no such invariant proved.'),
'356783':('PARK_POLYNOMIAL_BOUND','Conjecture5.2, 2211.03870v2. Existence of a finite move word is source-proved. Source discussion raises GL(n,2) order 2^n-1, so finite-order repetition does not produce a polynomial-length word.','Uniform polynomial word length respecting legal jumps, similarity and enlargement for every N>6; no complexity bound.'),
'356789':('PARK_DIAGRAM_POSITIVITY','Source Proposition4.12 and equation4.19 identify diagram positivity of m_lambda modulo I_H with all-poset monomial positivity. Conjecture4.14 is exact. Theorem4.13 proves positivity of J_lambda modulo I_plac, a different element and ideal. Earlier r362 related monomial record remains held.','Positive representative for every m_lambda modulo I_H, not J_lambda or selected partitions; no sign-preserving all-partition reduction.'),
'356804':('HOLD_ALGORITHM_FIDELITY','Latest source Question6.10 names Algorithm2.9, while literal record says Algorithm1. Conjecture6.8 is only an existence/rank inequality and cannot identify a given trimmed differential complex up to isomorphism.','Identify literal algorithm across versions and prove all matched differential cancellations yield a Barile-Macchia resolution with a chain isomorphism. No mere equal Betti ranks substitute.'),
'356831':('HOLD_MAXIMAL_MAXIMUM','Source v3 Conjecture22 says MAXIMUM domination for non-attacking queens, while literal says maximal. Every finite non-attacking queen set can be greedily extended to an inclusion-maximal independent set, which dominates its attack graph: an undominated cell could be added. Thus unrestricted inclusion-maximal existence is trivial, not the source size-threshold NP-completeness question.','Exact decision threshold/maximum-versus-maximal semantics and convex reduction with nonattackingness, row/column convexity and domination all maintained. Correction only, no credit.'),
'356917':('PARK_DENSITY_UPPER_BOUND','Conjecture5.4 exact a/b domain verified in primary v1. Definition1.3 supremum log t(H)/log t(G), not reversed abstract prose. Proposition2.6(a,c) prove both proposed lower bounds. Source Lemmas5.1/5.2 do not close the remaining regime; two extended attempts documented.','Universal graphon inequality t(K_b,W)>=t(K_a,W)^M at proposed M, including zero/one densities. Lower bounds alone are source-known helpers.'),
'356919':('PARK_ELBOW_CONSTRUCTION','Primary Theorem1 and Conjecture2 read. Matchings are vertex-disjoint, both orientations of the elbow are allowed, strict crossing excludes endpoint touch; source assumes distinct horizontal and vertical coordinates. Three-cluster source upper construction gives n/3, not n/4. Two attempted upgrades fail as documented.','An all-n general-position construction excluding every orientation/matching with more than floor(n/4) elbows, with perturbation and remainder handling. Figure1 not visually reviewed.'),
'356921':('PARK_TRIANGLE_EXTREMAL','Primary Conjecture16 exact. Intersecting means an interior crossing of edges of each pair; shared vertices alone do not count, while vertex disjointness is not required. Three edges per triangle gives only choose(3n,2)/3, larger than n^2.','A geometry-sensitive count removing excess over n^2 for arbitrary point sets; need every pair crossing and global edge disjointness in any witness. Convex lower construction is not upper proof.'),
'356989':('PARK_ANALYTIC','Primary Conjecture3.2 literal heavy-tail assertion read. Finite-graph degree samples alone are not a regularly varying unbounded law; require the actual random-graph/asymptotic setting and infinity-PageRank normalization.','Specify stochastic limit and prove regular variation transfers under the infinity nonbacktracking operator. Generic degree/PageRank analogy insufficient; no concrete full-scope mechanism.'),
'356999':('PUBLIC_EXACT_THEOREM_ZERO','2211.13826v1 Conjecture3.6, Theorem3.33 with proof chain3.32/3.17 and equations defining phi read. Source itself proves exact all-prime cycle statement; full bridge in ORDINARY-ATTEMPTS.md. Journal DOI10.1112/plms.12575 metadata only.','No new deduction; complete auxiliary reduction proofs/journal correction audit not performed. Source result already resolves literal assertion, not an eligible new solution.'),
'357051':('PUBLIC_EXACT_THEOREM_ZERO','Actual 2212.04527 Theorem1.1 says every isolate-free graph, Dominator starts, <=3n/5. Game rules, move-gift reduction, point invariants and concluding proof passages read. All-domain and floor bridge documented. Original2211.16432 is TOTAL game, which alone would not suffice.','No new deduction. All eleven strategy phases not independently audited; latest abs/journal chronology for counterpart not acquired because GET budget breach stopped network.'),
'368269':('PARK_STABLE_TRANSDUCTION','2505.00594v2 Conjecture1.1 and exact monadic-stability definition read. Stable source is preserved under transduction, so forward closure does not supply the reverse nowhere-dense presentation. Prior r340 stable/ordered decomposition is a different statement.','Construct nowhere-dense presenting class and one uniform interpretation for every stable hereditary class. Hard normal-form conjecture; compact park.'),
'371533':('PARK_BERGMAN_NOT_CHOW','2511.13819v2 Conjecture1.4 exact proper-flat order-complex h-polynomial. Source expressly distinguishes its Hilbert series from Chow-ring quotient. Earlier r318 ordinary Chow refutation is not a refutation of this polynomial. Augmented Bergman counterexamples also do not match.','All-matroid real-rootedness or exact nonpositive-root failure of this h-polynomial; UMEL-shellable subclasses alone insufficient.'),
'381872':('HOLD_PUBLIC_MATCHING_CLAIM','New assigned primary2212.09188v3 Conjecture1.3 read in this lane; no protected implementation read. Native search identified2607.13829, July15 2026, explicitly claiming exact path-reversed theorem. Body not acquired after GET breach, so precise public claim HOLD, not certified full bridge.','Read actual2607.13829 definitions/proof including all n and target ordering before public-resolution exclusion; not novelty-cleared. Generic rank lower bound must minimize over every transitive target order.'),
'349290':('PARK_STEINER_FLOW','2101.00867 Conjecture1.3 exact all STS(v)>7. Primary source only gives specific cyclic residue classes 3-flows and other cyclic cases 4-flows.','Integral incidence-kernel vector with every block weight nonzero and in {-2,-1,1,2} for every STS, including noncyclic. Rational kernel dimension or 4-flow not enough.'),
'349311':('BOUNDARY_CORRECTION_ZERO','Primary Observation3.2 valuation adjacency, source alpha1 star identity, Definition9 and Conjecture12 read. p=2,alpha=1 gives K2, eigenvalues 1,-1, energy2 equals order2, not strict hypoenergetic. This is a boundary/domain defect of the literal universal statement, excluded from discovery credit. Stronger all-parameter exploration in notes does not close corrected domain.','No eligible new mathematical result. Corrected all-parameter energy theorem remains unpaid; source alpha2 p>=7 estimates do not cover all alpha/primes.'),
'349357':('BOUNDARY_AND_ROUNDING_HOLD_ZERO','2101.03802v2 Conjecture2 literal unfloored bound; Theorem4 maximal planar n>=8. Literal all-n allows K4: planar,3-connected,no3-cut, circumference4<16/3. This is a missing-domain correction only. Native current primary Kessler2025/2002.07698 claims floor(2(n+4)/3), not ceil; body not acquired.','No new credit from K4/domain fix. On intended n-range, floor theorem cannot imply literal unfloored bound without congruence/strengthening; full source body and exact chronology remain HOLD.'),
'349451':('PARK_LEFSCHETZ','2101.07245v2 Conjecture7.1 exact extended g-vector with ceiling(d+s)/2. Source says biased-pairing method does not supply stronger injection. Index beyond d and small-s conventions need fidelity care.','An Artinian quotient with required Hilbert differences nonnegative and Macaulay growth for all s-CM complexes; existing Lefschetz range insufficient. No boundary-domain correction nominated.')}
res={}
for i,v in raw.items():
 status,reason,gap=notes[i];o=v['object'];res[i]={'mathdb_id':int(i),'title':o['title'],'canonical_url':o['canonical_url'],'literal_statement':o['statement'],'source_url':o['source_url'],'full_original_provenance':{'file':'raw-provenance.json','key':i,'chunk_path':v['chunk_path'],'chunk_sha256':v['chunk_sha256'],'line_one_based':v['line_one_based'],'raw_sha256':v['raw_sha256'],'statement_sha256':v['statement_sha256']},'disposition':status,'ordinary_investigation':reason,'exact_unpaid_lemma_or_qualification':gap,'credit':0,'gates':{'fidelity':'literal fully read; source comparison qualifications in ordinary_investigation','math':'public theorem match' if status.startswith('PUBLIC_EXACT') else 'boundary defect only' if status.startswith('BOUNDARY') else 'full target unpaid','prior':'bounded allowlisted history + 3 native calls/9 queries + current root metadata; no exhaustive clearance','novelty':'not established; public results and corrections excluded','significance':'no qualified new result','formal':'not attempted, no Lean or Pi endpoint','independent_review':'not performed','acceptance':'not accepted; zero'},'read_depth':{'literal':'full','metadata':'retrieved latest source abstract/version list; see metadata-access.json','primary':'selected actual text only, per notes/receipts; acquisition != reading','figure':'not visually inspected','full_proof_audit':False}}
assert len(res)==20 and set(res)==set(raw)
(p/'keyedresults.json').write_text(json.dumps(res,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print('WROTE',len(res),'keyed results; zero credit')
